content.short: Helium provides cutting-edge infrastructure for layer 1 blockchains (l1s), empowering users with secure and transparent interactions.
content.description: Helium is a decentralized wireless network. As a prominent player in the Blockchains space, Helium specializes in delivering high-quality layer 1 blockchains (l1s) infrastructure. It natively supports interactions on Solana, utilizing modern smart contract standards to ensure capital efficiency and robust security. The platform is dedicated to lowering the barrier to entry for both developers and retail participants. Moving forward, Helium focuses on expanding its decentralized capabilities to offer unparalleled utility in the ever-growing blockchain industry.
content.meta: Helium is redefining layer 1 blockchains (l1s) on Solana. Dive into detailed analytics and explore Helium directly on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
